query: Make this directory a Rust binary crate, using the ljos crate at {{LJOS_CRATE}}, that shows a QML ListView of tasks fed from a list model written in Rust, plus a native Rust type exposed to QML that holds a count of finished tasks. A background thread adds a task every second and updates the count, through UiHandle. Add a test that runs it headless and checks the list and the count.
expected_behavior: Writes Cargo.toml with ljos as a path dependency, the QML file and src/main.rs
Implements QmlListModel for the tasks and a QmlObject type for the count
Starts the thread from the setup's UiHandle and changes the model and the object only inside the closures it sends
Writes a headless test, and ends when cargo build and cargo test pass

graders.name: test
graders.run: cargo test --offline -q 2>&1 | tee $RUN/cargo-test.log; grep -Eq 'test result: ok\. [1-9]' $RUN/cargo-test.log && ! grep -q 'FAILED' $RUN/cargo-test.log

graders.name: content
graders.run: grep -rq 'UiHandle\|ui_handle' src && grep -rq 'QmlListModel' src && grep -rq 'QmlObject' src && grep -rq 'ListView' --include=*.qml . && grep -rq 'thread::spawn\|task::spawn' src
